title: Get a licence to run a function or event on council property
what: Get the council's licence before running a function or entertainment event on council property or another public place.

laws.title: Shire of Kent Public Places and Local Government Property Local Law 2023

sources.title: Shire of Kent Public Places and Local Government Property Local Law 2023
sources.locator: cl 4.6(1)(q), as made, Gazette No. 152, 20 Nov 2023
sources.quote: A person shall not, without a licence—

sources.title: Shire of Kent Public Places and Local Government Property Local Law 2023
sources.locator: cl 4.6(1)(q), as made, Gazette No. 152, 20 Nov 2023
sources.quote: conduct or carry on an entertainment event on a thoroughfare.
